Canvas.ReferenceDisplayHint.zh: 选择屏幕并重置透视画布。
Canvas.ReferenceDisplayHint.en: Choose a display to reset the perspective canvas.

Canvas.MultiMonitorHelp.zh: 拖动中央把手移动画布；下拉菜单可选择重置屏幕。
Canvas.MultiMonitorHelp.en: Drag the center handle to move the canvas. Use the reset menu to choose a display.

Canvas.DragBoundary.zh: 已到达透视边界；拖动中央把手可整体移动。
Canvas.DragBoundary.en: Perspective limit reached. Drag the center handle to move the canvas.
